scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @game/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @game/shared dev" "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: corepack enable && pnpm install && pnpm --filter @game/shared build && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.build:e2e: pnpm --filter @game/shared build && pnpm --filter client exec tsc && pnpm --filter client exec vite build --mode e2e && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @game/shared exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter server exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter client exec vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=webkit --project=mobile-chromium && pnpm --dir e2e run test:extended
scripts.test:e2e:fast: pnpm build:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: pnpm build:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=webkit
scripts.test:e2e:extended: pnpm build:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e run test:extended
scripts.test:e2e:mobile: pnpm build:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=mobile-chromium
scripts.test:e2e:debug: pnpm build:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --ui
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @game/shared build && tsc --noEmit -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json

simple-git-hooks.pre-push: pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:css && pnpm check:balance && pnpm lint:instructions
